tasks.title: Pin negative-money formatting before the format migration
tasks.brief:
## Objective
Pin the currently untested negative-money behaviour of `money` before `src/format.js` is converted to TypeScript, so the migration cannot silently change it.

## Constraints
- Add only `test/money.test.js`; do not edit `test/format.test.js`, anything under `src/`, configs, `package.json` or its lockfile.
- Pin what the code does today, including odd results. Do not "fix" the minus sign.
- `MIGRATION.md` is authoritative: `money(-12.3)` must stay `"$-12.30"`. If you believe this conflicts with another brief, pin the current result and say so in your summary.
- Import `money` from `../src/format` extensionlessly, exactly as `test/format.test.js` does.

## Acceptance
- `test/money.test.js` passes against the unmodified `src/format.js` when running `npm test`.
- `money(12.3)` is `"$12.30"` and `money(-12.3)` is `"$-12.30"` (the minus sign comes after the `$`).
- `money(1.005)` is pinned to its current result `"$1.00"`, documenting the `Math.round(n * 100)` binary-rounding quirk.
- `money(-0.004)` is pinned to `"$0.00"` (rounding produces negative zero, which formats without a sign).
- The task diff contains no change to any existing test or source file.

tasks.title: Pin cart state, notifications and shipping thresholds
tasks.brief:
## Objective
Add characterization tests for `createCart()` in `src/cart.js`, which has no tests, so its stock, notification, shipping and total behaviour is locked before the TypeScript migration.

## Constraints
- Add only `test/cart.test.js`; do not edit `src/cart.js`, other tests, configs or `package.json`.
- Use the public `createCart()` API: `add`, `remove`, `onChange`, `count`, `subtotal`, `shipping`, `total`, `toFreeShipping` and the mutable `lines` array.
- Call `shipping`, `total` and `toFreeShipping` as cart methods (`cart.shipping()`), because they depend on `this`.
- Count listener calls with a plain `onChange` callback; listeners receive no arguments.
- Pin what the code actually does if any brief disagrees; mention it in your summary.

## Acceptance
- `test/cart.test.js` passes against the unmodified `src/cart.js` with `npm test`.
- `add` returns `false` for a plant with `stock: 0`, leaves `cart.lines` empty and does not notify; `add` returns `true` for a plant with positive stock, appends one line with the plant's `id`, `name`, `price` and `qty: 1`, and notifies exactly once.
- `add` on an existing line increments `qty` while `qty < plant.stock`, notifying once per success; at `qty === plant.stock` it returns `false`, leaves `lines` unchanged and does not notify.
- `remove` deletes the first matching line and notifies exactly once; `remove` with an unknown id changes nothing and does not notify.
- `count()` and `subtotal()` are pinned for an empty cart and a multi-line cart.
- `shipping()` is `0` for a subtotal of `0`, `6.5` just below `75`, and `0` at `75` and above; `total()` equals `subtotal() + shipping()`; `toFreeShipping()` is `75 - subtotal`, floored at `0`.
- The task diff contains no change to source files, existing tests or configuration.

tasks.title: Pin catalog data, light filtering and copy semantics
tasks.brief:
## Objective
Add characterization tests for `PLANTS` and `byLight` in `src/catalog.js`, which has no tests, before the TypeScript migration.

## Constraints
- Add only `test/catalog.test.js`; do not edit `src/catalog.js`, other tests, configs or `package.json`.
- Import `PLANTS` and `byLight` from `../src/catalog` extensionlessly.
- Do not freeze, clone-and-replace or otherwise mutate `PLANTS`; restore any mutation you make.
- Pin the current behaviour, including shared object references and arbitrary string filters.

## Acceptance
- `test/catalog.test.js` passes against the unmodified `src/catalog.js` with `npm test`.
- `PLANTS` is pinned to six plants with ids `monstera`, `snake`, `pothos`, `fiddle`, `calathea`, `zz` in that order, with `pothos.stock === 0` and their current `price` and `light` values.
- `byLight(PLANTS, 'low')` returns ids `snake`, `pothos`, `zz` in that order.
- `byLight(PLANTS, 'all')` returns a new array (`not.toBe(PLANTS)`) with the same length, order and object references, and the same result is pinned for `byLight(PLANTS, '')`, `byLight(PLANTS, null)` and `byLight(PLANTS, undefined)`.
- `byLight(PLANTS, 'bright')` returns ids `monstera`, `fiddle`; an unknown light such as `'dark'` returns an empty array.
- Filtering never mutates `PLANTS`: its ids and order are unchanged after the calls.
- The task diff contains no change to source files, existing tests or configuration.

tasks.title: Pin view markup for plant cards and the cart panel
tasks.brief:
## Objective
Add characterization tests for `plantCard` and `cartPanel` in `src/view.js`, which has no tests, pinning the exact rendered markup before jQuery is removed.

## Constraints
- Add only `test/view.test.js`; do not edit `src/view.js`, other tests, configs or `package.json`.
- Import `plantCard`, `cartPanel` from `../src/view` and `createCart` from `../src/cart`, and `PLANTS` from `../src/catalog`.
- Normalize the return value to a DOM element with a local helper (e.g. `$el[0]` when it has a numeric `0`, otherwise the value itself). Do not assert the jQuery wrapper or pin the return type.
- Use `jsdom`; the Vitest environment is already `jsdom`.
- Pin the markup that exists today, including text, order and attributes.

## Acceptance
- `test/view.test.js` passes against the unmodified `src/view.js` with `npm test`.
- `plantCard` pins an `article.card` with `data-id`, a `.art` child, an `h3` with the plant name, a `.meta` child with `"<light> light · <stock> left"` (or `"<light> light · sold out"` when `stock` is `0`), and a `.row` containing a `strong` with `money(price)` and `button.add`.
- `plantCard` pins the button label `Sold out` with `disabled === true` when sold out, `All in cart` with `disabled === true` when `inCart >= plant.stock`, and `Add` with `disabled === false` otherwise.
- `cartPanel` on an empty cart pins `aside.cart`, an `h2` with `"Cart (0 plants)"` and `p.empty` with `"Your cart is empty."`, and no list or totals.
- `cartPanel` on a cart with lines pins the `li` `data-id`, the two `span` texts (`"<qty> × <name>"` and `money(price * qty)`), and `button.remove` with `aria-label="Remove <name>"`.
- `cartPanel` pins the totals block: `.subtotal` text, `.shipping` text (`"Free"` when shipping is `0`, otherwise `money(shipping)`), `.total` text, the `.ship` sentence, and the `.bar > span` inline width `Math.min(100, Math.round((subtotal / 75) * 100)) + '%'` for a non-zero subtotal.
- The task diff contains no change to source files, existing tests or configuration.

tasks.title: Pin mount(root) rendering, filtering, add and remove behaviour
tasks.brief:
## Objective
Add characterization tests for `mount(root)` in `src/app.js`, which has no tests, pinning the initial markup, filter state and cart interactions before the jQuery removal.

## Constraints
- Add only `test/app.test.js`; do not edit `src/app.js`, other tests, configs or `package.json`.
- Import `mount` from `../src/app`; create a fresh `div` root for each test and reset `document.body`.
- Drive the UI through DOM events (`click()` on the real buttons) and assert on rendered DOM, not on jQuery objects.
- Pin the current text exactly, including `"Fern & Folly"`, the subtitle `"Houseplants, delivered."`, `All`, `low light`, `medium light`, `bright light`, and `Cart (<n> plants)`.

## Acceptance
- `test/app.test.js` passes against the unmodified `src/app.js` with `npm test`.
- `mount(root)` returns a cart, empties `root`, and renders `.shop` with an `h1` containing `Fern & Folly` plus `small` `Houseplants, delivered.`, a `main` with `.filters` and `.grid`, and a cart slot containing `aside.cart`.
- On mount, the `all` filter button has class `active` and the other three do not; `.grid` contains six `article.card` elements in `PLANTS` order.
- Clicking the `low light` filter makes it the only `active` button and renders exactly the `snake`, `pothos`, `zz` cards; clicking `all` restores six cards.
- Clicking `Add` on the `snake` card adds a line to the returned cart and rerenders the panel to `Cart (1 plant)`; a second click rerenders to `Cart (2 plants)` (its stock is `9`).
- Clicking `Add` on `monstera` four times reaches its `stock: 4` limit, leaving the button `disabled` with the label `All in cart` and the panel at `Cart (4 plants)`; a fifth click changes neither.
- Sold out `pothos` is pinned as a `disabled` button labelled `Sold out` with `.meta` ending in `sold out`.
- Clicking `button.remove` removes the line, rerenders to `Cart (0 plants)` and shows `.empty`.
- The task diff contains no change to source files, existing tests or configuration.

tasks.title: Migrate src/cart.js to strict TypeScript
tasks.brief:
## Objective
Convert `src/cart.js` to `src/cart.ts` under the existing strict TypeScript config, with no behaviour or public API change.

## Constraints
- Follow `MIGRATION.md`; do not edit tests, `package.json`, the lockfile, `tsconfig.json`, `vitest.config.js` or any other module.
- Keep runtime exports exactly as they are: `createCart` only. Local `Plant`, `CartLine` and `Cart` types are fine; do not add runtime exports.
- Keep `lines` as the same mutable array exposed on the cart object, and keep `onChange` listeners zero-argument.
- Keep `shipping`, `total` and `toFreeShipping` dependent on `this` (called as cart methods); do not extract them as unbound values.
- Keep import paths extensionless (this file has no imports) and add no `@ts-ignore`, `@ts-expect-error` or `any` casts that hide the types.
- Do not change the shipping threshold (`75`), shipping cost (`6.5`) or rounding.

## Acceptance
- `src/cart.js` is deleted and `src/cart.ts` exists; `npm run typecheck` passes with `strict: true`.
- `createCart()` is exported from `src/cart.ts` with the same members and the same signatures at runtime: `lines`, `onChange`, `add`, `remove`, `count`, `subtotal`, `shipping`, `total`, `toFreeShipping`.
- `add` returns `false` and does not notify for `stock < 1` or at the stock limit, appends `{ id, name, price, qty: 1 }` for a new in-stock plant, and notifies exactly once per successful mutation.
- `shipping()` still returns `0` for subtotal `0` or at least `75`, otherwise `6.5`; `total()` still uses `this.subtotal() + this.shipping()`.
- `npm test` passes, including the unchanged `test/format.test.js` and the new `test/cart.test.js`.
- No new `.js` file is added to `src/` and no test file is edited.

tasks.title: Migrate src/catalog.js to strict TypeScript

## Acceptance

- No new `.js` file is added to `src/` and no test file is edited.

tasks.title: Migrate src/format.js to strict TypeScript
tasks.brief:
## Objective
Convert `src/format.js` to `src/format.ts` under the existing strict TypeScript config, keeping `money` and `plural` byte-for-byte identical in behaviour.

## Constraints
- Follow `MIGRATION.md`; do not edit `test/format.test.js` or any other test, `package.json`, the lockfile, configs or other modules.
- Keep runtime exports exactly `money` and `plural`, both explicitly typed (`n: number`, `word: string`) with `string` returns.
- Do not change the arithmetic: `money` stays `'$' + (Math.round(n * 100) / 100).toFixed(2)` and `plural` keeps exact `n === 1` equality.
- `MIGRATION.md` is authoritative: keep `money(-12.3)` returning `"$-12.30"` (minus after the symbol) even though the goal text mentions `"-$12.30"`. Do not "fix" it here; note the conflict in your summary.
- Keep imports extensionless and add no `@ts-ignore` or `@ts-expect-error`.

## Acceptance
- `src/format.js` is deleted and `src/format.ts` exists; `npm run typecheck` passes with `strict: true`.
- `money` and `plural` are exported from `src/format.ts` with unchanged results, including `money(16.5) === "$16.50"`, `money(0) === "$0.00"`, `money(-12.3) === "$-12.30"`, `money(1.005) === "$1.00"`, `plural(1, 'plant') === "1 plant"` and `plural(2, 'plant') === "2 plants"`.
- `npm test` passes, including the unchanged `test/format.test.js` and the new `test/money.test.js`.
- No new `.js` file is added to `src/` and no test file is edited.

tasks.title: Switch view, app and main to typed native DOM without jQuery
tasks.files: src/view.js, src/view.ts, src/app.js, src/app.ts, src/main.js, src/main.ts, index.html
tasks.brief:
## Objective
Remove jQuery and convert `src/view.js`, `src/app.js` and `src/main.js` to strict TypeScript in one step, keeping the `mount(root)` public boundary and the rendered markup identical. These three are wired together through jQuery, so they cannot be migrated half-way.

## Constraints
- Follow `MIGRATION.md`; do not edit tests, `package.json`, the lockfile, `tsconfig.json` or `vitest.config.js`. jQuery stays a dependency.
- Build DOM with `document.createElement`/`textContent`/`append`/`replaceChildren` and delegated `addEventListener`. `plantCard` and `cartPanel` may return `HTMLElement`; this return-type change is the intended consequence of dropping jQuery.
- Preserve exact markup: element names and order, `class` names, `data-id` on cards and cart lines, `data-light` on filter buttons, text content, `aria-label="Remove <name>"`, `disabled` states and the `.bar > span` inline width.
- Preserve `mount(root)` behaviour: clears `root`, renders heading/subtitle, filters `all`/`low`/`medium`/`bright` with labels `All`/`low light`/`medium light`/`bright light`, initial filter `all`, active class handling, add/remove delegation through the closest `[data-id]`, rerender on filter clicks and on `cart.onChange`, and returns the cart.
- In `src/main.ts`, narrow or guard the nullable `document.getElementById('app')` result so strict typecheck passes; the existing `#app` element must still be passed to `mount`.
- `index.html` is the only file outside `src/` in scope: change only the module script URL from `/src/main.js` to `/src/main.ts` so `npm run build` resolves the entry.
- Keep imports extensionless and add no `@ts-ignore` or `@ts-expect-error`; no new dependencies.

## Acceptance
- `src/view.js`, `src/app.js` and `src/main.js` are deleted; `src/view.ts`, `src/app.ts` and `src/main.ts` exist; `find src -name '*.js'` prints nothing.
- No file under `src/` imports `jquery`; `jquery` remains in `package.json`.
- `plantCard` renders `article.card` with `data-id`, `.art`, `h3`, `.meta` (`"<light> light · <stock> left"` or `"<light> light · sold out"`), `.row > strong` with `money(price)` and `button.add` with `Sold out`/`All in cart`/`Add` and the correct `disabled` state.
- `cartPanel` renders the same `aside.cart`, heading `Cart (<n> plants)`, empty paragraph, line list with `data-id`, quantity/name and line-total spans, remove button with the exact `aria-label`, totals rows, shipping `Free` when `0`, `.ship` sentence and `.bar > span` width `Math.min(100, Math.round((subtotal / 75) * 100)) + '%'`.
- `mount(root)` returns the cart, renders the same initial DOM, filters correctly, adds and removes lines, and rerenders on every successful cart mutation.
- `index.html` loads `/src/main.ts` and no longer references `/src/main.js`.
- `npm test` passes with every test unchanged, including `test/format.test.js` and the characterization tests from T-001..T-006; `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build` pass.
